name: Pick
text:
Decision: Focus first on Reddit and GitHub as our primary sources for AI info mining.

Why: Both platforms have high-quality, up-to-date discussions and projects. Reddit’s niche AI communities (like r/MachineLearning) and GitHub’s open-source AI repos give us raw, unfiltered insights. We can quickly spot trends and real-world use cases here.

Trade-off: We’re skipping Product Hunt and Telegram for now, which might mean missing some early-stage launches or niche discussions. But those sources are harder to mine at scale, and Reddit/GitHub give us the best balance of speed and relevance.
